summary: PO msg 407 E2E — Backend pytest 11/11 (test_enea_costing_msg407 + test_global_discount_msg407) + 2/2 new PDF/RBAC (test_msg407_pdf_rbac). Frontend UI E2E all 7 sub-flows PASS (10% manual, PROMO10, NOPE rejected, remove, reload persist, sidebar totals, tachometer visible admin). Two UI bugs discovered but backend behavior fully correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Thousand separator missing for amounts < 10.000. Rendered as '9000,00 €' / '1000,00 €' / '1980,00 €' / '4000,00 €' / '3650,00 €' instead of '9.000,00 €' etc. Cause: ICU 72+ default useGrouping='auto' → 'min2' for it-IT, so integers with a single grouping (<10000) aren't grouped. Spec (msg 407) explicitly expects 'Sconto 10% = − 1.000,00 €' and 'Imponibile 9.000,00 €'. Fix: pass useGrouping: 'always' (or true) to Intl.NumberFormat in fmtEUR helpers (QuoteEditorPage.jsx L26 and other pages: Dashboard.jsx, GoalsPage.jsx, ErpOpsPage.jsx, CustomerQuotesTab.jsx).
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid=quote-global-discount], right sidebar Totali (Imponibile/IVA), Riservato Direzione block

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid promo (NOPE) → backend returns 400 with detail={code:'PROMO_CODE_UNKNOWN', message:'Codice sconto non applicabile'} (object). formatApiError() only handles string / array / {msg} shapes, so falls through to String(detail) → '[object Object]' shown in error toast. Spec requires user-visible 'Codice sconto non applicabile' / 'PROMO_CODE_UNKNOWN'. Fix: extend formatApiError to handle {message} or {code, message} shape (return detail.message || detail.code || JSON.stringify(detail)).
ui_bugs.selector: toast.error after quote-promo-apply-btn with invalid code

action_items: Fix formatApiError in /app/frontend/src/api/client.js to unwrap {message}/{code,message} objects (returned by /api/quotes PATCH on promo/discount errors) so the user sees 'Codice sconto non applicabile' instead of '[object Object]'.

Fix fmtEUR (QuoteEditorPage.jsx L26 + Dashboard/Goals/ErpOps/CustomerQuotesTab) to pass useGrouping:'always' to Intl.NumberFormat('it-IT', …) so 4-digit amounts render as '1.000,00 €' / '9.000,00 €' per PO msg 407 spec.

OPTIONAL RBAC hardening (spec ambiguous but suspicious): commercial GET /api/quotes/{id}.financial_snapshot currently exposes commission_gross (1350), commission_rate (0.15), final_company_margin (40.5556), net_revenue_ex_vat (9000), margin_band. Spec says 'only tachometer_value etc.'; strictly-forbidden fields (supply_cost, other_direct_costs, pre_commission_margin, pre_commission_contribution, final_company_contribution) are correctly hidden. Consider stripping the rest if PO intent was truly minimal.
critical_code_review_comments: quotes.py:294 raises HTTPException(status_code=400, detail={'code': ..., 'message': ...}) — good structured error, but every frontend caller relies on formatApiError which does NOT handle this shape. Either unify backend errors to {msg: ...} or upgrade formatApiError (recommended).

QuoteEditorPage.jsx L390: Sconto row renders `${q.global_discount_value}%` even when discount is applied via promo (source=PROMO_CODE) — currently gated by q.promo_code so it correctly says 'promo PROMO10'. OK.
